# Supported Devices

<!-- Auto-generated by scripts/generate_supported_devices.py — do not edit by hand. -->
<!-- Regenerate with: python scripts/generate_supported_devices.py -->

The library currently knows **271** device models and the features each one supports. Models not listed here are still discovered, but fall back to on/off control only. If your device is missing or its capabilities are wrong, please [open an issue](https://github.com/Galorhallen/govee-local-api/issues).

Devices with scene support share the same scene set: sunrise, sunset, movie, dating, romantic, twinkle, candlelight, snowflake, energetic, breathe, crossing.

Color temperature defaults to 2000-9000 K; models with a narrower or wider range declare their own.
